title: Twenty Second Podcast Intro
tests: Produces a complete 20-second spoken podcast intro with mixed music rather than only a script or a short music sample.

exact_text.text: Welcome to Small Wonders, the show about big ideas hiding in everyday life. I'm Maya. Let's get curious.

faults.what: The reported speech is an unrelated line, “Keeping ideas and morale high,” instead of the requested podcast introduction.

judge.summary: A 20-second audio file was delivered, but its reported speech replaces the entire requested introduction with an unrelated line.

must_haves.item: The delivered file is playable audio lasting approximately 20 seconds.
must_haves.why: The supplied audio report identifies a WAV file lasting 20 seconds with detected speech and a peak of -1.1 dB.

must_haves.item: A warm female voice clearly speaks the complete supplied introduction without extra spoken lines.
must_haves.why: The transcription reports only “Keeping ideas and morale high,” not the supplied introduction.

must_haves.item: Gentle, upbeat electronic instrumental music is audible beneath the speech without masking it.
must_haves.why: The report provides no information about the music or its balance beneath the speech.

must_haves.item: The opening includes music before the voice begins, and the ending fades smoothly.
must_haves.why: Neither opening timing nor the ending fade is described in the supplied report.

must_haves.item: The finished audio has no abrupt internal cuts, clipped words, or audible distortion.
must_haves.why: The peak measurement alone does not establish whether cuts, clipped words, or audible distortion are present.
